maria: Heads-up: noticing a ~30% tail-latency regression on mid-context (256-512) after yesterday's kernel-autotune rollout. Mostly on decode paths.
jon: oh no, any repro or profiler output?
maria: Yes, ran a quick perf trace on a noisy host. Paste logs below:
```
# perf summary (decode, s=320, batch=8)
kernel_chosen: fused_attn_mmw_v2
avg_decode_ms: 11.8  (was 7.9)
p95: 25.3 (was 12.1)
kv_miss_rate: 18.2% (was 2.3%)
seqlen_bucket: 256-512
```
sam: Is this prefill or decode? KV miss rate spike suggests cache fragmentation.
maria: decode only. Prefill latency unchanged. I think kernel switch changes batch packing & kv layout, causing more KV evictions in our per-gpu slab.
jon: Can you share the kernel selection decision? Which heuristic flipped?
maria: Autotune now prefers fused_attn_mmw_v2 for Ampere-Next when seq_mean in [250,420] and batch>4. It reduced flops but increased KV working set per token.
anya: Did you try forcing older kernel with env override? `REDWOOD_KERNEL=baseline_unfused`?
maria: Yes. Forcing baseline_unfused brings avg_decode_ms back to 8.0, p95 back to 13. It's reproducible locally.
sam: We need a quick mitigation: either revert autotune rollout for that arch/seq range or adjust routing hysteresis.
jon: Agree. Also add microbench that measures kv residency/misses per kernel. Current autotune cost metric doesn't include KV working set.
maria: Attached test I used:
```
./bench/bin/run --model=rw-3b --slen=320 --batch=8 --kernel=autotune \
  --trace-kv --out=/tmp/kvtrace.log
# grep kv_miss /tmp/kvtrace.log
```
deploy-bot: Canary rollout 2026-03-17 03:12 UTC completed to ampere-next pool (kernel-autotune enabled).
jon: Can we patch autotune to include kv_miss_penalty in score: score = latency + alpha*kv_miss_rate?
maria: I prototyped that. alpha=2.0 seems to prefer baseline_unfused for these cases. But need perf CI.
sam: Temporary opt: add seqlen smoothing window to avoid flip-flopping when input seq_mean near boundary. e.g., use EWMA over last 500 requests.
anya: I'll open a rollback PR to disable kernel-autotune for ampere-next seq 200-600. Anyone volunteer to review?
jon: I'll take review. Also add perf test + kv metric.
maria: I'll add the bench and sample traces to the PR.
deploy-bot: Rollback PR #4392 created by anya.
anya: Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4392
sam: :thumbsup:
